entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I need to make a return. I think. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you provide me with the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Oh, um, sure. The email is sam.jones@email.com. It's for a helmet I bought.
Thank you, Sam. I see your order for the Trail Helmet here. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just... the color. It didn't look like the picture on the website. I ordered the 'Forest Green' and it's much brighter in person. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
I understand. Getting the right color is important, especially for gear you'll be wearing often. Let me just check the purchase date for you. One moment.
Okay. I know it's been a little while. I've just been so busy. I'm just so overwhelmed with everything. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I see the helmet was delivered 71 days ago. Let me pull up our policy... Okay, great news. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Oh! Really? That's a relief. So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're within the 90-day window, I can start the return process for you. We want to make sure you're happy with your equipment and your personal safety is paramount, so getting the right gear is key. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, that's so much easier than I thought. Thank you, David. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Sam. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
Happy to help. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
